artworks.title: Girl, with Another Rubbing Her Belly
artworks.description: The image shows abstract forms and figures. There are two stylized figures depicted with minimal linework and shading. One figure seems to be reclining on a surface with arms positioned casually, while the other figure is more upright and facing towards the reclining figure. The background and figures are rendered with simple lines and subtle texturing, conveying a sense of intimacy and interaction. The composition uses the contours of the figures to create movement and space within the canvas.

artworks.title: Dancers in Studio
artworks.description: The image depicts flowing and angular lines creating an abstract representation of two human figures amidst geometric shapes. One figure wears an angular dress and interacts with abstract background shapes, while the other figure is sketched with curving lines suggesting movement, with a pattern resembling stripes.

artworks.title: Harbor at Burgstaaken
artworks.description: The image shows a dock area with boats from an elevated viewpoint. The composition includes architectural and natural elements, with a boat in the foreground. In the background, there are buildings and a tall, thin structure against the sky. The style is characterized by bold lines and crosshatching, creating movement and texture. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of beige and black to emphasize the scene's linear quality and depth.

artworks.title: Couple in Front of a Carriage
artworks.description: This abstract composition features intersecting lines and shapes that suggest human figures and a carriage. Vertical lines may represent standing figures, some with hat-like shapes. Circular forms in the center resemble wheels, surrounded by clustered lines conveying texture and movement. The artwork evokes a busy street scene with people and a carriage, blending linear and curved motifs with familiar elements.

artworks.title: Seehorn
artworks.description: The image depicts an abstracted landscape scene featuring a mountainous terrain with swirling clouds above. Bold brushstrokes outline the forms in a monochromatic color palette of deep blacks, beige, and off-white. Various sharp, jagged lines suggest elements like trees or structures.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape with Little Mowers
artworks.description: The image depicts a mountainous landscape with rugged peaks, sketched in expressive strokes. The monochromatic color palette uses shades of black and gray. Sloping terrain leads to the peaks and dark sky. The sky is heavily shaded, contrasting with the lighter tones of the mountains. The style suggests an etching or printmaking technique with textures and strong contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Goats and Clouds
artworks.description: The image shows swirling and jagged lines crisscrossing the composition, creating an abstract landscape. Some lines resemble trees, while others suggest animals or mythical creatures. The top features swirling lines that look like clouds or smoke, adding a sense of dynamic movement. The arrangement invites viewers to search for familiar objects within the chaotic scene.

artworks.title: Heads of Two Girls
artworks.description: The image displays intersecting lines and curves creating abstract shapes resembling human profiles. The composition implies faces leaning towards each other, with the use of delicate and bold lines adding depth. Facial features like eyes and lips are hinted at with minimalistic strokes, suggesting people in a contemplative interaction.

artworks.title: Two Peasant Heads
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the shoulders upward. The man on the left is shown in profile with a thick mustache and straight, dark hair. His eyes are closed, and he has a prominent nose and furrowed brows. The man on the right faces slightly more towards the viewer, showcasing a full beard and mustache, with his eyes open. Both men wear simple clothing. In the background, there is another smaller person with arms slightly extended. The background features sketchy lines and shading, adding depth and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: Women at a Table in a Room (recto) / Nude Woman (verso)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint with surface etching (recto) / graphite drawing (verso)
artworks.description: The image features intricate lines and dark shapes creating an abstract representation. Within these patterns, there are outlines resembling figures around what looks like a table. Some figures have head coverings, and there are elements suggesting a vase or pitcher on the table. The use of shadow and textures adds depth to the image, evoking familiar scenes despite its abstract style.

artworks.title: Women at a Table in a Room
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and surface etching
artworks.description: The image displays bold, jagged lines and textured shading in an abstract composition. The outlines suggest figures resembling people around a table. Shapes resembling human faces, a vase, and a bottle are present. The overlapping forms create a dynamic flow across the image, inviting exploration of its complexity.

artworks.title: Alpine Huts in Fog
artworks.description: The image depicts a house in the center, with two figures nearby - one working with a tool and the other standing. In the background, mountain shapes are visible. The style includes rough brushstrokes and a limited monochromatic color palette from light grays to dark blacks.

artworks.title: Peasant and Girl
artworks.medium: color etching printed in black, red and blue
artworks.description: The image displays a composition of lines and shapes that form the silhouettes of two figures, one red and the other blue, against a textured background. The abstract artwork suggests human forms, creating a sense of conversation or interaction. The red figure on the left appears to lean on a surface, while the blue figure on the right stands upright. In the top left corner, an outline of a window is visible, hinting at an interior scene.

artworks.title: The Wanderer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing in a mountainous landscape. The scene is depicted with simple, bold lines that suggest the contours of the mountains in the background and the valleys in the foreground. The figure in the center appears to be a stylized representation with exaggerated features. The drawing also features a small structure placed in the left mid-ground. The overall composition is stark and expressive, emphasizing the roughness and solitude of the scene.

artworks.title: Young Woman with Child
artworks.description: The image shows a line drawing of two figures: an adult and a child. The adult is seated upright with an angular face, pronounced cheekbones, and shoulder-length hair. She wears a long-sleeved top with patterns. The child sits in front, wearing a dress with puffed sleeves and a hat. The child looks forward, legs hanging down. The setting includes a chair and an object resembling a picture frame in the background.

artworks.title: The Painter
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated and leaning slightly forward with their head turned to the right. The person has sharply defined facial features and dark, short hair. They are wearing a garment with long sleeves and a large cross insignia on the chest. The background includes an abstractly drawn sculpture or object on the right side and simple etched lines suggesting a corner or wall.

artworks.title: Girl with Flowers
artworks.description: The image shows abstract lines and shapes with an outline of a person playing an instrument in a lush backdrop. The drawing has an abstract feel of a dense forest, with lines suggesting tall grasses or slender trees, and large, rounded shapes resembling leaves or floral patterns. The image offers glimpses of natural elements like flowers and foliage surrounding the figure.

artworks.title: Cycle Race
artworks.medium: drypoint proof printed in brown-black ink and touched with graphite
artworks.description: The image displays an intricate composition of curved and straight lines intersecting and diverging across the canvas. The abstract arrangement forms figures resembling people engaging in cycling and lounging, with a central bicycle. These figures are connected to objects like bicycles, with human forms depicted in different poses suggesting a social or communal setting. The shapes of wheels and human heads contrast with the angular lines of limbs and backgrounds, creating a dynamic scene.

artworks.title: Mountain Stream with Bathers
artworks.description: The image displays swirling and intersecting lines on a textured background, creating an abstract composition. The lines form a complex pattern resembling a chaotic yet harmonious dance. There are hints of familiar forms such as wisps of smoke or loose strands of hair, adding organic movement to the design.

artworks.title: From the Apocalypse
artworks.description: The image shows a series of wavy and flowing lines across the canvas, creating dynamic shapes and forms. The abstract composition contains figures resembling birds or people with wings, their elongated forms suggesting movement. In the lower portion, there are additional abstract forms that could be interpreted as a gathering of figures, with their limbs blending into each other and the surrounding lines. The scene suggests motion and fluidity, reminiscent of a surreal landscape populated by ethereal beings.

artworks.title: Mountain Slope with Goats
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated perspective looking down on a landscape of rolling hills and jagged lines suggesting vegetation. There is no distinct horizon line; instead, the scene flows upward from close to us into the distance, with hills sloping towards the background. The technique used involves sketch-like lines creating texture and movement across the hills and suggested elements like trees. The color palette is monochromatic, with black, grey, and off-white shades creating contrast that emphasizes the linear elements of the composition, highlighting the rugged and abstract quality of the landscape.

artworks.title: Still Life
artworks.medium: color lithograph printed in yellow, blue and red
artworks.description: There is a tall vase with white flowers on a round table with a patterned tablecloth. The color scheme includes greens, yellows, blues, and reds. The vase is placed on the right side of the image and there is a small bowl near its base on the table. The background is filled with dense foliage patterns and shadows.

artworks.title: Old Market in Dresden with a Fair (Der Altmarkt in Dresden mit Jahrmarkt)
artworks.description: The image showcases bold, expressive lines and geometric shapes, especially in the building forms at the top. The scene is abstract with sharp angles and rounded arches resembling a cityscape. Subtle curves and arches within structures suggest windows and rooftops, while darker, merging strokes at the bottom imply figures in a bustling urban setting. The composition incorporates architectural elements in a dynamic and abstract way.

artworks.title: Men Splashing in the Reeds (Sich Spritzende Männer im Schilf)
artworks.description: The image shows sweeping and jagged lines converging to form two human-like figures in a highly stylized and abstract manner. The figures have bold and dark shapes with elongated limbs and exaggerated features. They appear to be engaging with each other against a backdrop of thick, uneven strokes that could be interpreted as a forest or flames. The abstraction blurs the boundaries of form and space, inviting viewers to ponder connections to the human body and nature.
